expression.description: Cron expression (5 fields: minute hour day month weekday) or shortcut (@daily, @hourly, etc.). Example: '0 9 * * 1-5'. Defaults to '@daily'.

from_iso.description: ISO 8601 reference timestamp to compute next runs from (default: now).

next_runs.description: Number of upcoming run times to return (default 5, max 20).
